edges.reason: msg.sender is the mint recipient and is used in every per-address balance check.
withdrawFunding authorization compares msg.sender against owner() and _saleWallet.
msg.sender is mixed into the randomness seed.
adoptDogs gates minting on block.timestamp < _saleEndTimestamp, a timestamp dependency.
activateSale derives the sale end from block.timestamp.
block.timestamp is part of the randomness seed.
adoptDogs invokes _safeMint, which performs an external receiver callback while the mint loop is still running.
onERC721Received gives control back to the caller during the adoption loop, before refund and final effects.
Excess payment is pushed with transfer after the minting loop.
withdrawFunding pushes the entire balance to an external payable wallet.
adoptDogs calls generateRandomDogSpecs for each minted token.
generateRandomDogSpecs repeatedly calls generateRandomNumber.
adoptDogs performs counter increments, supply additions and msg.value - price subtraction.
adoptDogs increments and reads _tokenIdCounter for new token ids.
adoptDogs writes generated specs into _tokenToDog.
adoptDogs requires _saleActive to be true.
adoptDogs requires block.timestamp to be before _saleEndTimestamp.
PRICE_PER_DOG is multiplied by amount to derive the required payment.
MAX_SUPPLY bounds amount and total supply.
MAX_AMOUNT_PER_ADDR limits balanceOf(msg.sender) + amount.
activateSale flips _saleActive and is protected by onlyOwner.
activateSale writes _saleEndTimestamp and is protected by onlyOwner.
Sale duration in seconds uses DAY_IN_SECONDS.
Sale duration uses SALE_DURATION_IN_DAYS.
setSaleWallet rewrites the fund receiver and is onlyOwner.
Constructor initializes _saleWallet with walletAddr.
transferOwnership rewrites _owner under onlyOwner.
renounceOwnership clears _owner under onlyOwner.
withdrawFunding reads _saleWallet both for authorization and as transfer destination.
generateRandomNumber relies on predictable chain values, producing weak randomness.
amount drives supply, per-address and price arithmetic in adoptDogs.
newWallet becomes the privileged fund receiver via setSaleWallet.
walletAddr is stored into _saleWallet at deployment.
seed is packed into the randomness hash.
range determines the modulo output of the randomness.
tokenId selects the DocSpecs returned by the getters.
newOwner becomes the new privileged owner.
price participates in price = PRICE_PER_DOG * amount and msg.value - price.
client is the payable receiver of the refund transfer.
randomHash is the weak randomness output used for attribute selection.
newDog is the DocSpecs returned by generateRandomDogSpecs.
mainColor is assembled inside generateRandomDogSpecs.
secondaryColor is assembled inside generateRandomDogSpecs.
itemRandomizer selects the item attribute branch.
specs is loaded from _tokenToDog in the getter functions.
getPrimaryColor reads _tokenToDog.
getSecondaryColor reads _tokenToDog.
getEars reads _tokenToDog.
getTongue reads _tokenToDog.
getBodyShape reads _tokenToDog.
getItem reads _tokenToDog.
Getters validate tokenId against _tokenIdCounter.
saleEndTimestamp returns _saleEndTimestamp.
saleIsActive returns _saleActive.
saleWallet returns _saleWallet.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter amount is only meaningful inside adoptDogs and should be folded into that function node.
Parameter newWallet only feeds the setSaleWallet setter.
Parameter walletAddr is only used to initialize state in the constructor.
Parameter seed is consumed only by generateRandomNumber.
Parameter range is consumed only by generateRandomNumber.
Parameter tokenId is a transient lookup key for the external getter functions.
Parameter newOwner only affects the transferOwnership access-control action.
Local price exists only to compute payment inside adoptDogs.
Local client is the receiver of the refund transfer unsafe operation.
Local randomHash is the weak randomness value produced for attribute generation.
Local newDog is the return structure of generateRandomDogSpecs.
Local mainColor is assembled only inside generateRandomDogSpecs.
Local secondaryColor is assembled only inside generateRandomDogSpecs.
Local itemRandomizer drives the item branches in generateRandomDogSpecs.
Local specs is a temporary read of _tokenToDog inside the getters.
